# Disposable Lefthook/Git smoke

Run `scripts/quality-gate-smoke.sh` from any directory. It builds a local `quality-gate` binary, creates a disposable Git repository and bare remote under `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}`, and removes them on exit. It installs Lefthook only in that fixture. It does not use a model provider, network service, global Git configuration, or the source repository's hooks.

The script checks the generated policy against Go and CUE, merges the generated hook fragment with existing pre-commit and commit-msg witness commands, inspects `lefthook dump`, and runs installed Git hooks. It plants invalid JSON in the index while leaving valid working bytes and demands a refused commit with both witnesses observed. A valid commit and an empty commit must pass; the empty commit must invoke the commit-msg witness and `quality-gate` against the empty staged index. A real bare-remote initial push must pass, then a two-ref push containing one deliberately invalid fixture commit must be rejected without updating either ref. Direct multi-ref stdin, explicit observe, missing policy, and malformed stdin are checked separately.

The invalid fixture commit uses `git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null` inside the disposable repository solely to seed the pre-push rejection case. It does not alter the installed hook or any project gate. This is a local integration proof. CI branch protection, production adoption, model quality, and saved review effort require separate evidence.

Run receipt (2026-10-22): `TMPDIR=/Volumes/m2ext/tmp/agentic-kit-build scripts/quality-gate-smoke.sh` exited 0. Git 2.54.0, Go 1.26.3 (darwin/arm64), CUE 0.16.1, Lefthook 1.13.6; source `69f5efcfafd5` plus the uncommitted working-tree implementation. Installed commit-msg refused staged invalid JSON while the worktree held valid JSON; existing pre-commit and commit-msg witness jobs ran. Valid and empty commits passed, with the empty commit running the installed commit-msg quality gate and witness. Initial full-tree push passed. Installed pre-push rejected a two-ref push with one invalid committed revision; neither remote ref moved. The direct multi-ref command emitted two ref receipts and held. Observe returned 0 with an observed result; missing policy and malformed stdin returned 2.

**Hook placement:** Lefthook 1.13.6 skips its `pre-commit` jobs on an empty staged set with `no matching staged files`. The generated fragment uses Git's `commit-msg` hook for the `pre-commit` policy boundary so an empty commit still reaches the staged-index check. The existing pre-commit witness remains installed and runs on ordinary commits. [Lefthook's own discussion](https://github.com/evilmartians/lefthook/discussions/504) documents file-based skip behavior. Local hooks remain bypassable; the required trusted-base CI status is the enforcement boundary.
